interest: Finding aid for 1940–44 Japanese government reporting, plus loyalty pledges from Japanese American groups.
overview: List of Papers for 894.01 (Government of Japan), November 1940–January 1944, indexing reports on the Tripartite Pact, Tojo's wartime measures and new ministries, plus Japanese American loyalty pledges.
